title: BridgePoint Global Offline World
description: Download worldwide geographic foundations. Regional detail and live information are clearly separated from static global data.

packages.title: Global Borders
packages.description: Worldwide land shapes and country borders at three Natural Earth scales, including detailed 1:10m boundaries for offline use.
packages.bestFor: Low-storage devices and global outline navigation

packages.title: Global Basemap
packages.description: One planet-wide vector archive at zoom levels 0–6, with generalized roads, water, landcover, transport and place context at supported scales.
includes: Worldwide roads and transport context at overview scale

packages.title: GLOBAL MAX — Open Data
packages.description: The largest bundled worldwide package: a richer zoom 0–7 global vector archive plus detailed Natural Earth country/land boundaries and local labels/symbols. Target size is a few hundred megabytes, not multiple gigabytes; the exact archive size and source date are recorded in the build metadata.
packages.sizeLabel: About 250–400 MB · exact size recorded per build
includes: Everything in Global Basemap, plus an expanded zoom-7 world archive
Country and land geometry at Natural Earth 1:10m / 1:50m / 1:110m scales
Global roads, waterways, transport and place context at available zooms
Local fonts, symbols, source date and licence notices
packages.bestFor: Maximum globally redistributable map detail in one reasonable download

layerAvailability.title: Detailed buildings and 3D structures
layerAvailability.note: High-detail building geometry is not universally available worldwide under one common licence. Zoom-0–6 global map data is not a replacement for detailed footprints.

layerAvailability.title: Parcel boundaries and cadastral records
layerAvailability.note: Coverage and redistribution rights vary by jurisdiction. Regional packages must pass source and licence checks before being offered.

layerAvailability.title: High-resolution terrain and LiDAR
layerAvailability.note: Detailed global elevation/LiDAR is not in the compact global package. Higher-resolution terrain requires separate regional packages.

layerAvailability.title: Aerial and satellite imagery
layerAvailability.note: Imagery is large and often provider/licence restricted; it cannot honestly be included without suitable redistribution rights.

layerAvailability.title: Weather, radar and emergency alerts
layerAvailability.note: Only dated snapshots can be used offline. Live radar and new alerts need connectivity or a separate radio/data source.

layerAvailability.title: Device-to-device emergency mesh
layerAvailability.note: Not shipped in this release. Offline maps do not themselves create Bluetooth/Wi-Fi multi-hop communication.
